source_policy: Use the author's archived curated data, not a new merge of current Pyrfume main.
author_raw_to_curated: Retain workbook checkpoints; expert curation and original download commit are not reproducible from supplied code.
cohort_stage: Author cell 2 after exact-string SMILES deduplication, required-value filtering and label construction; before singleton-stratum filtering/splitting.

feature_spec.combination: Morgan concatenated with eight descriptors; user-requested v7 representation

fragment_policy: Preserve author records for audit; flag disconnected structures. Do not silently apply v7's single-component exclusion or approve them for training.
split_policy: Diagnose author's positional indexing without correcting or adopting a training split.
label_policy: Keep 200 observed labels and report the author's 100-label >=30-slot subset. No replacement with v7's 109 labels.
comparison_claim: Same archived source data; documented common preparation checkpoint; intentionally different features. Not identical pre-ML to Suh.

future_ml.split: pending review of reference indexing and duplicate-feature overlap
future_ml.optuna: not configured or run at this stage
future_ml.baseline_recipe: Suh code is documented; exact historical dependency versions unavailable
future_ml.evaluation: Freeze common labels/splits/threshold policy before fitting; macro AP plus the six reference metrics. Published scores are not a paired control.
